memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux
  - Status: New diagnosis, typical heartburn after meals, regurgitation, no alarm symptoms.
  - Plan: Start pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, domperidone 10 mg BD before meals, antacid gel SOS. Advise small frequent meals, avoid spicy/fatty foods, no lying down within 2 h after food. Weight 68 kg, waist 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm, within limit).
  - Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the pantoprazole each morning and domperidone twice daily. The heartburn has improved; I only need antacid gel occasionally after heavy meals. No nausea or vomiting.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux
  - Status: Improved, heartburn 1‑2 times weekly, regurgitation rare, using antacid gel SOS ≤2 times/week.
  - Plan: Continue pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast, reduce domperidone to 5 mg BD before meals, continue antacid gel SOS. Reinforce meal timing, avoid late‑night snacks. Weight 67 kg, waist 77 cm (within limit).
  - Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

  - Plan: Continue current regimen. Consider tapering pantoprazole to 20 mg OD after 4 weeks if symptoms remain absent. Weight 66 kg, waist 76 cm (within limit).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Gastro-oesophageal reflux
  - Status: Symptoms recurred over past month, heartburn 3‑4 times weekly, mild regurgitation after large meals, antacid gel SOS used daily.
  - Plan: Increase pantoprazole to 40 mg OD before breakfast (restart full dose), continue domperidone 5 mg BD before meals, add sucralfate 1 g SOS after meals. Review diet, avoid late meals. Weight 68 kg, waist 79 cm (approaching female cut‑off 80 cm).
  - Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
